documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0: PAHT-CF
Bambu PAHT-CF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701N04
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility
ASA CF / PAHT CF Usage Guide

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties, dry state); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 47 ± 5 MPa, elongation 4.1 ± 1.2 %, bending modulus 1820 ± 170 MPa, bending strength 61 ± 5 MPa, impact 13.3 ± 0.8 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 3860 ± 230 MPa, Z 2180 ± 130 MPa), melt index (14.4 ± 2.0 g/10 min at 280 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (140 °C, DSC 10 °C/min), heat deflection temperature 194 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.88 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.8 - 1.4 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70°), max bridging length (~ 40 mm), spool material (PC + ABS, temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size (200 × 67 mm), suggested annealing (80 to 130 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (45 - 60 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu PAHT-CF", model "N04-xx", CLP "Not classified", the section 8 carbon-fibre handling warning (gloves when loading, cutting or sanding), and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO/IATA) transport. Its section 8 reads "carbon fiber-reinforced filament （Glass fiber-reinforced filament)", a wording slip in the SDS. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 260 - 290 °C vs material-table wiki 260 - 300 for PAHT-CF/GF); bed temperature (TDS 80 - 100 °C vs material-table wiki 90 - 110 °C in its glue table and 100 - 120 ℃ in its plate table); AMS lite (store page and ASA CF / PAHT CF wiki "not compatible" vs the material-table wiki's combined AMS / AMS lite column "Bambu PA-CF, PAHT-CF Compatible"). The product TDS values and the product-specific statements are kept.

Marketing prose proves no number: "With a 50% lower water absorption rate compared to normal PA-CF", "Low Moisture Absorption", "Exceptional Mechanical Properties & Layer Adhesion" and "High Tensile Strength" are not stored as values; the Mechanical Properties Comparison and Z-layer charts on the store page are images.
No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its only colour value "Black (70100)" has no published hex.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/40190d6568d7406bacb58b3bcb09b783.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.

The ASA CF / PAHT CF wiki links its own TDS and MSDS copies (wiki.bambulab.com/filament-acc/asacf-pahtcf/65f1b18a6d6142d794a1a6a00f1496ef.pdf and 94155f1b8f31469d88991dc3ac3e58f0.pdf); they were not cached and not read. The store-linked TDS V3.0 and SDS SDS20260701N04 were read.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 5); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

The store page says "Note: PAHT-CF is an upgraded version of PA-CF (PA-CF was discontinued)."; the store FAQ (4.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade" and warns of hard microscopic splinters; no registry key holds these.
